description:
Surfaced during Arc 65 (stoa--z2b) by ADA's tp3 fixture work; floor-manager (POLYBIUS_the-stoa) verified by direct probe.

GAP: the authorship gate's cfg extractor regex (_hooklib.sh extract_author_fields, cfg branch) anchors every author-like FIELD with a mandatory separator: (?ix)(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])[quote]?(FIELD)[quote]?\s*[:=]\s*(.*)$ . The 'copyright' field therefore matches 'Copyright: <name>' and 'copyright = <name>' but does NOT match the STANDARD license form 'Copyright (c) <year> <name>' (no :/= after the field word). Probe confirmed: 'Copyright (c) 2026 Fenwick Galsworthy' -> NO match (ALLOW); 'Copyright: Fenwick Galsworthy' -> match (BLOCK).

IMPACT: a real LICENSE / LICENSE.md / NOTICE naming a NON-DENSON person in the conventional 'Copyright (c) <year> <Name>' line slips the gate — a true-positive MISS in the gate's core purpose (the directive's named LICENSE/NOTICE block-class). The most common real-world copyright surface is exactly the un-matched form. the-stoa's own LICENSE names Denson, so not actively mis-attributed today, but a fork/downstream is exposed.

PRE-EXISTING + OUT OF ARC-65 SCOPE: the cfg extractor is byte-identical/unchanged by Arc 65 (which only narrows the .md matcher). Arc 65 does NOT make this worse; r1's LICENSE.md->cfg closure is validly proven by tp6/tp3 using the matchable colon form. This is a separate defect in the cfg extractor.

PLAN (concrete next-step): DAEDALUS designs a copyright-aware pattern that ALSO matches the separator-less standard form — e.g. for the 'copyright' field specifically, allow an optional '(c)'/(C)/© + optional year before the name: 'Copyright\s*(\(c\)|©)?\s*(\d{4})?\s+<name>'. Must NOT widen false-positives (prose like 'copyright is held by...' / 'the copyright field' must still pass) — needs its own adversarial both-directions corpus (mirror the Arc-65 tp/fp structure). Blocker: none; this is a scoped security-gate change warranting its own small arc after Arc 65 lands. NEXT ACTION: when picked up, start from the Arc-65 corpus harness (substrate/hooks/tests/) and add copyright-form fixtures (standard + colon + prose-negative).

CONSIDER (Arc-65-adjacent, PLINY/DAEDALUS call): a one-line honesty note in the Arc-65 corpus README that LICENSE coverage is the 'field: value' separator form and the standard 'Copyright (c) <year> <name>' form is a known un-matched gap tracked here — so the green corpus is not read as 'all LICENSE formats covered.'
title: [BUG] author-gate cfg extractor requires :/= separator — standard 'Copyright (c) <year> <name>' LICENSE line is NOT matched (true-positive MISS)
